# Alpha Universe

> > Alpha Universe is Sony's official community and resource hub for Alpha mirrorless camera users, featuring photographer profiles, gear announcements, and creative storytelling.

The site showcases Sony's Alpha camera ecosystem including the α7R II, α7S, RX100 IV, and RX10 II series, featuring professional photographers (Artisans), creative projects, and detailed camera technology coverage from full-frame sensors to 4K video capabilities.

## Key Topics

- Sony Alpha mirrorless cameras
- α7R II full-frame camera
- α7S video-focused camera
- RX100 IV compact camera
- RX10 II bridge camera
- 5-axis in-body image stabilization
- Back-illuminated full-frame sensor
- 4K video recording
- XAVC S codec
- Focal-plane phase detection AF
- Sony Artisan photographer program
- Mirrorless camera technology
- Professional photography
- Videography and filmmaking
